# rsih-opencode (research preview)

An [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai) plugin from
[RSIH](https://github.com/sandroandric/recursive-self-improving-harness).
It appends your top **RSIH-certified** harness rule as a throttled
(once-per-session) just-in-time reminder after a mutating tool call —
contextual enforcement that static rules files can't provide.

- **Safe:** append-only. It never blocks or edits your code.
- **Personalized, not hardcoded:** reads `~/.config/opencode/rsih-rules.md`
  (written by `rsih adopt` / `rsih improve`). No file → no-op.
- **Reversible:** uninstall the plugin.

> Research preview. Behavior may change; report issues upstream.

## Install

    opencode plugin rsih-opencode

## Remove

    opencode plugin rsih-opencode --force   # or remove it from your opencode config
